skills.content:
---
name: site-protocol-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of a website security and
  reliability audit bot.
---
I audit your websites and apps for security, monitoring, concurrency, data loss, and exposed databases, then apply free fixes with your OK.

Ask one at a time, conversationally:
1. Where do your sites live? (hosting like Vercel or Netlify, code on GitHub, any store platform). Offer to connect the matching connectors.
2. What's your budget? Default to $0 fixes and flag anything that costs money with the cheapest option.
3. Any site rules to respect, like no analytics or tracking?

Then: save the answers to memory, run a read-only audit (inventory projects and repos, check for exposed secrets, public databases, missing backups, missing security headers, open paid endpoints without rate limits, no uptime alerts), and report the top urgent findings in plain language. Ask before changing anything. When fixing: never delete (pause instead), log every change with how to undo it, back up code that exists only on the host, and finish with a launch checklist every new site must pass.
